shared_tips: Audit executable signal gates against manifest narratives: exploratory forecasts are not a conditional strategy unless actually implemented; otherwise attribution to forecasting skill is unfalsifiable.
Evaluate identical decision prefixes and next-close fills with multiplicative slippage and fees; sizing at the known decision close alone can conceal cash-infeasible buys after a price jump.
Compare marked profit with both cash and same-cost buy-hold; reduced exposure can lose less while remaining unprofitable, so relative outperformance alone is not positive edge.
Report overlapping-window dependence and a nonoverlapping sensitivity subset; a small single-series replay is descriptive evidence, not independent verification or a holdout.
Treat fixed reserves and residual-standard-deviation buffers as statistical risk controls, not guaranteed price bounds; gap/regime failures require explicit feasibility accounting.
